_doc: Golden Dataset for the conversation eval harness (Phase 3.8 step 0). Each scenario drives AgentSession text-to-text with scripted CLIENT turns and hard-scores the resulting STATE + replies. The LLM only phrases; verdict/walker are deterministic given these turns, so state outcomes are stable. Checks: verdict_in (expected verdict seen), disposition (resolved|ticket|outage|open), reply_any (>=1 reply contains), reply_none (no reply contains — regression guard for known bugs). Scenarios flagged 'known_bug' are EXPECTED to fail now and turn green after the Phase 3.8 fix.
